description: A terms bucket aggregation — one bucket per distinct value of field.

field.description: Required. The column to bucket by.

size.description: Optional. Maximum number of buckets to return. Capped server-side.

shard_size.description: Optional. Number of candidate buckets collected per shard before the final reduce. Capped server-side.

min_doc_count.description: Optional. Minimum document count for a bucket to be returned. Default and minimum 1; 0 is rejected.

shard_min_doc_count.description: Optional. Per-shard minimum document count before a bucket is considered. Minimum 1; 0 is rejected.

show_term_doc_count_error.description: Optional. Whether to return the per-bucket document-count error bound.

order.description: Optional. Bucket sort order — a {metric: "asc|desc"} object or an array of them.

include.description: Optional. Terms to include — a regex string or an array of exact values.

exclude.description: Optional. Terms to exclude — a regex string or an array of exact values.

missing.description: Optional. Bucket value assigned to documents missing field.

format.description: Optional. Format applied to the bucket key in the response.

value_type.description: Optional. Explicit value type for the field when it cannot be inferred.
